id: title:Gilbert09:stop a resumed repartition re reading copied rows

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion resumption and cost optimization
review.reason: Adds helper functions to read Delta table metadata and skip already-processed source files during warehouse ingestion resumption, reducing redundant I/O and CPU cycles. This could lower ingestion costs and improve throughput when operations are restarted.
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation and its effectiveness depend on the warehouse connector and metadata availability, which are not fully demonstrated in this chunk. The benefit is potential rather than realized.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds import for pyarrow.dataset and two new helper functions: _rows_per_source_file and _drop_copied_source_files. These functions read metadata from a Delta table and a FileSystemDataset, then skip whole source files whose row counts are already accounted for in a resume operation, rather than re-scanning them.
observations.posthog_connection: This could reduce redundant I/O and CPU cycles during warehouse ingestion resumption, potentially lowering costs and improving throughput when a rewrite operation is restarted after a budget or deadline interruption.
